{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in body_mass_g
missing_body_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].isna().sum()
print(f'Missing body_mass_g values: {missing_body_mass}')

# Drop rows with missing body mass values
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute the mean body mass in grams
mean_body_mass = penguins_clean['body_mass_g'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_body_mass"}
